Description 
Reviews (0) 
Keysight N9048B CISPR 16 EMI Receiver for EMC test analysis is easy to set up and use. Fully compliant receivers are only required for certifying products. The EMC Shop stocks ISO 17025 calibrated Keysight N9048B’s to help minimize downtime for test labs or allow military and avionics manufacturers to get an in-depth insight into what the test labs will see from their product during emissions testing.
In EMC testing, success depends on tools that can help you do more in less time—today and tomorrow. That’s why Keysight (Agilent) created the MXE: a standards-compliant EMI receiver and diagnostic signal analyzer built on an upgradeable platform. In the lab and on the bench, it provides the accuracy, repeatability, and reliability you need to test with confidence. Equip your team with the MXE, and keep the test queue flowing.
Keysight N9048B PXE is a standards-compliant EMI test receiver equipped with an RF pre-selector and LNA designs. Shorten your overall test time and easily perform gapless signal capture and analysis with real-time scan (RTS) capabilities.
Keysight’s new EMI test receiver, the “N9048B PXE”, with Accelerated Time Domain Scan, supports the widest band in the industry.  The test receiver is fully compliant with CISPR 16-1-1 and MIL-STD-461.  The Accelerated Time Domain Scan feature covers 350MHz, the widest frequency range in the industry. This feature allows emissions measurements to be conducted much faster and more accurately.
The Keysight N9048B PXE is a test receiver that evaluates EMI compliance with CISPR 16-1-1:2019, MIL-STD-461G, ANSI C63.2, and FCC requirements. It is also an X-Series signal analyzer that can run various measurement applications.
Keysight N9048B Key features
Frequency Range: 1 Hz to 3.6 GHz, 8.4 GHz, 26.5 GHz or 44 GHz
Full compliance with CISPR 16-1-1:2019, MIL-STD-461G, ANSI C63.2 and FCC standards
Types of detectors used in EMI measurements: peak, quasi-peak, average and RMS
Max. real-time analysis bandwidth: 350 MHz
Main technical characteristics
Total level measurement error: ±0.22 dB
Average floor noise level (DANL) (1 GHz):
-174 dBm (with preamp and NFE noise cancellation)
Phase noise: -114 dBc/Hz (1 GHz), 10 kHz offset
EMI measurement, diagnostic tools, calibration
EMC measurement functionality: simultaneous detectors, signal lists, scan tables, limit lines and correction factors
Scanning Capabilities in Time and Frequency Domains
Advanced Analysis Tools: Strip Chart, Marker Functions, Span Zoom, Zone View, and Spectrogram Display
Use in automated measuring systems
LXI Class C compliant, SCPI command support
Interfaces: USB 2.0, LAN 1000Base-T, GPIB
Multi-touch user interface for all X-Series signal analyzers / Windows 10 open operating system
More confidence in EMC testing
Improve test accuracy and repeatability with outstanding measurement accuracy (±0.22 dB) and sensitivity (-174 dBm at 1 GHz)
EMC measurement applications, marker functions, swath zoom, area view and spectrogram display
Equipping the laboratory with a flexible tool for testing new products and new types of products in the frequency range from 1 Hz to 44 GHz
Combining the functions of an EMI receiver and a spectrum analyzer into a single unit for faster evaluation of the fine structure of the signal
Real-time time domain scanning feature continuously captures and analyzes signals up to 350 MHz and displays results in frequency, time and spectrogram views
Code Compatibility with Keysight N9038A MXE Receiver
Upgradeable to meet current and future testing needs
Standard Features of PXE Receivers
The Spectrum Monitor feature adds a live spectrum and meter display, making it easy to characterize signals and identify frequency peaks before final measurements. Number of graph points: 1 to 100,001
The amplitude probability distribution (APD) function is included in the CISPR 11 standard.
The External Line Impedance Conditioner (Line Dummy) Control function allows you to control the switching process of two commercially available line impedance circuit converters used for conducted interference measurements in commercial and military compliance tests.
Disturbance Analyzer function to measure EMI from household appliances, electric tools, etc. in accordance with CISPR 14-1
Key Specifications
Keysight´s N9048B PXE is a standards-compliant EMI test receiver equipped with an RF pre-selector and LNA designs. Shorten your overall test time and easily perform gapless signal capture and analysis with real-time scan (RTS) capabilities.
Frequency range of 1 Hz – 44 GHz
Fully CISPR 16-1-1:2019, MIL-STD-461G, ANSI C63.2, and FCC compliant
Industry leading sensitivity and dynamic range
Time domain scan (TDS) significantly reduces overall test time
Intuitive multi-touch user interface and PXE software
X-Series upgradability to meet present and future test needs
